title: Quantify breadth-versus-cap-weight divergence after large-cap chip selloffs
reason: Closing reports show an unusual divergence between the headline index and advancing-versus-declining issues. Primary KRX breadth, market-cap, turnover and investor-flow data are not yet connected, so causality and contribution remain unconfirmed.
hypothesis: The headline index drawdown was disproportionately concentrated in mega-cap semiconductors while the median listed stock was materially stronger.
counter_hypotheses: Advancers may have been small and low-turnover, so turnover-weighted breadth could still show broad risk-off.
Foreign selling may reflect market-wide de-risking rather than a semiconductor-specific rotation.
Post-holiday price discovery may temporarily exaggerate cap-weight versus breadth divergence.
required_primary_sources: KRX investor-type net flows by issue/sector
acceptance_criteria: retain source/as_of/retrieved_at provenance for every primary row
compute divergence on at least 20 comparable sessions before assigning rarity
separate raw breadth, turnover-weighted breadth and cap-weight contribution
keep evidence HYPOTHESIS until KRX primary rows validate the close and breadth
